data.name: Ashes of the Belt
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

ASHES OF THE BELT is a top-down space shooter built around fast runs, heavy firepower, and satisfying progression—without the usual friction. There’s no inventory management, and you don’t lose your run rewards if you die or decide to end a run early. Jump in, fight, collect, upgrade, and push further each time.

You’ll battle across space and planet surfaces, harvesting resources from dangerous zones while enemies grow stronger the longer you survive. Your goal is simple: build a loadout that feels powerful, adapt to escalating threats, and take on boss fights that demand more than just raw damage.

Voiced Companions (2 Unique Specialists)

Bring one of two fully voiced companions into your runs—each with a clear identity and upgrade path:

Valkyra — Rockets Specialist (Fun Companion)
Explosive pressure, rocket-focused upgrades, and brutal burst moments that reward aggressive play.

Arc — Laser Specialist (Cold Tactican Companion)
A high-tech laser approach with precision-focused upgrades and clean, controlled damage.

Your companion choice doesn’t just add personality—it shapes your run strategy and how you approach fights.

Weapons (8 Distinct Playstyles)

Choose from 8 different weapons, each designed to feel unique and support different builds:

  • Basic Bullet

  • Canister Flak

  • Laser

  • Minigun

  • Multi Stage Rocket

  • Rocket Launcher

  • Swarmer Rocket Launcher

  • Shotgun

Whether you prefer consistent sustained fire, high burst explosives, or crowd-control patterns, there’s a weapon that matches your style—and the game lets you lean hard into it.

Talent System (14 Talents per Weapon)

Every weapon comes with 14 talents, allowing deep specialization. Instead of one “correct” upgrade path, you can shape your loadout around what you enjoy—more speed, more impact, more utility, or more raw damage. The talent system is made to scale over time and keep runs feeling fresh.

Abilities (6 Unique Abilities)

On top of your weapon and companion, you can unlock 6 unique abilities. These add extra layers to combat—mobility, timing windows, survival tools, and offensive options that can turn a bad situation into a winning run. Mixing abilities with talents is where builds start to feel truly personal.

Maps & Encounters (4 Maps)

Fight across 4 different maps, each with its own enemy presence and resource flow. Different asteroid layouts and threats change how you position, how you farm, and how you commit to fights. Runs aren’t just about damage—they’re about knowing when to collect, when to push, and when to escape.

Boss Battles & Scaling Difficulty

As you progress, enemies and bosses scale to keep the challenge meaningful. Boss fights are designed as real tests of your build: can you sustain damage, control space, and survive long enough to finish the job? The deeper you go, the more your decisions matter.

Unlimited Upgrade Shop

Progress doesn’t stop after a handful of upgrades. The Unlimited Upgrades Shop lets you keep investing into your power and experiment with different directions. Keep refining your build, push new combinations, and see how far you can take a weapon/companion setup.

Flipper-Style Resource Refining

Refining resources isn’t a boring menu—it's a flipper-style refining system that turns processing into something active and satisfying. It adds a unique rhythm to the loop: fight, collect, refine, upgrade, repeat—always moving forward.

Optional Risk: Rift Gate Run Multipliers

Want higher stakes? The Rift Gate lets you activate optional run multipliers to increase intensity. It’s there when you want to push yourself—without forcing that pressure on every run.

No Inventory, No Punishment

ASHES OF THE BELT is designed to keep momentum high:

  • No inventory management

  • No punishment for ending a run

  • No loss if you die

You keep what you earned and can jump back in immediately—focused on action, progression, and experimentation.

data.short_description: Blast through alien-infested space in a modern top-down shooter built for quick runs and big upgrades. Mine planets for resources, unlock talents, and team up with voiced companions—no inventory management, just pure action between the shop and the fight.

*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-4xxx / Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750 Ti / GT 1030 / RX 550 (DX11)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8xxx / Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1650 / GTX 1060 / RX 580 / RX 6500 XT
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur (or newer)
  • Processor: Intel i5 (quad-core) or Apple Silicon (M1)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU (Intel HD 6000 / AMD Radeon / Apple integrated)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey (or newer)
  • Processor: Intel i5/i7 (6th gen+) or Apple Silicon (M1/M2)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU (discrete AMD preferred)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 (64-bit) or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel i5-4xxx / Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750 Ti / GT 1030 / RX 550 (Vulkan or OpenGL)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
